proof_scope: Opt-in live provider proof for Persona Dream journal authoring. This fixture may submit to live browser providers and is intentionally separate from the default retained suite.

claims.proves: The Persona Dream journal authoring lane can run through current live WebGPT and WebKimi provider receipts, validate journal_authoring, write dream_journal.v1.json, and produce journal_speech_plan.json.
claims.does_not_prove: Default retained readiness; provider availability outside the current browser session; paid media generation; human perceptual quality.

capability_claims.description: Journal authoring readiness requires actual live WebGPT and WebKimi provider receipts bound to the current journal source packet, not fixture-shaped local receipts.

cases.name: live-webgpt-webkimi-journal-authoring-e2e
cases.description: Runs the actual live Persona Dream journal authoring lane on verified browser-oracle tab bindings: live Memory source packet, WebGPT browser draft, WebKimi browser humanization from the inline sanitized bundle, journal_authoring validation, journal write, and speech plan readback.

cases.name: journal-authoring-rejects-missing-webkimi-live-proof
cases.description: Fails closed when a journal_authoring receipt is missing a passing live WebKimi receipt.
command:
uv run --project .. python - <<'PYCODE'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '../scripts')
from dialogue_authoring import validate_journal_authoring_receipt
receipt={
  'schema':'persona_dream.journal_authoring_receipt.v1',
  'source_packet_sha256':'sha256:source',
  'webgpt':{'handler':'webgpt','status':'PASS','provider_live':True},
  'webkimi':{'handler':'webkimi','status':'NEEDS_ATTENTION','provider_live':False},
  'humanized_journal':{
    'journal':'A source-bound journal.',
    'arc_assessment':{'opening_state':'careful','turning_point':'receipt gate','ending_state':'blocked','unresolved_tension':'missing proof'},
    'chatterbox_utterance_text':'[sigh] A source-bound journal.',
    'sfx_after':[],
    'delivery_notes':{'tone':'careful'},
    'entity_relationships':[]
  }
}
parsed, summary = validate_journal_authoring_receipt(receipt, source_packet_sha256='sha256:source')
assert parsed is None, parsed
assert summary['status']=='BLOCKED_JOURNAL_AUTHORING_RECEIPTS', summary
assert 'webkimi_receipt_not_pass' in summary['failed_gates'], summary
print('JOURNAL_AUTHORING_MISSING_WEBKIMI_LIVE_PROOF_REJECTED_OK')
PYCODE
